items.q: How do I join the party?
items.a: Scan the code on the TV with your phone camera, or go to partyplay.com.au/play and type the party code. There is no app, no sign up and no password.
Any nickname you like. It is the only thing you have to give, and it is how everyone at the party sees you.

items.q: It says there is no party with that code
items.a: Check the code against the TV, letter by letter, and try again. If it still will not go, ask your host to check the party screen is open and showing the same code.

items.q: Is this gambling? Do I need to pay?
items.a: No. PartyPlay is for fun at a private party. Nobody pays to join, there are no entry fees and no tickets to buy, and the games never handle money.

You give a nickname, and an email only if you want the photo album sent to you. Your nickname, and your email unless you ticked to hear from us, are deleted with the party's album 30 days after it ends. The full privacy policy is at partyplay.com.au/privacy.
Use the form below and we will reply by email, or email support@partyplay.com.au. For anything about the games tonight, your host is the quickest help.
Put the party screen on your TV or a laptop. Guests scan the code on it, or type the party code at partyplay.com.au/play, and put in a nickname.
Up to 50. That is the most any party can have, and there is no upgrade beyond it.

When you press start, not when you pay. A party runs for 24 hours or 3 days, depending on which you bought, and you confirm it on screen first so it cannot start by accident. Building your games beforehand is free and does not start the clock. A licence you never start lapses 12 months after purchase.

items.q: Is this gambling? Can we play for money?
items.a: No. PartyPlay is for private parties and the games never handle money: there are no entry fees, no tickets to sell and no cash prizes. A licence used commercially can be ended without a refund.

Changed your mind within 7 days of buying, before pressing start: full refund. After 7 days, before pressing start: your licence is still there for a year. Once you have pressed start: no refund. For anything about a payment, email accounts@partyplay.com.au.

Guests give a nickname, and an email only if they want the photo album. The album, nicknames and emails are deleted 30 days after the party ends. The full privacy policy is at partyplay.com.au/privacy.
